lens.payload: {"score": 8, "findings": [{"file": "scripts/lib/compat.sh", "category": "injection", "severity": "low", "message": "The load-time probe array _ZB_SED_INPLACE_ARGS is not declared readonly, so any code in the same shell process that runs after compat.sh is sourced can append or replace its elements, injecting extra sed arguments (e.g. -e or -f flags) into every subsequent zbuild_sed_inplace call.", "quote": "declare -a _ZB_SED_INPLACE_ARGS", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}, {"file": "scripts/lib/helpers.sh", "category": "missing input validation", "severity": "low", "message": "_zb_target_mode_v guards _ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD with ${_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD:-}, so if the variable is unset or cleared after load (e.g. by a test that sources helpers.sh then runs unset _ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD) the function silently falls through to the BSD stat -f branch on a GNU host, returning mode 600 for every existing file.", "quote": "if [[ \"${_ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD:-}\" == \"-c\" ]]; then", "introduced": true, "fix": "code"}]}
